aspect_scores.evidence: Most guests call rooms clean or spotless, but three report musty damp carpet, bathroom mold, and a room not properly cleaned.
Staff are often described as warm and helpful, but others report slow check-in, an unanswered desk phone, and no action on a noise complaint.
Cinnamon rolls, coffee and pastries are praised, but others report packaged muffins, few hot options, running out of food, and minimal choice.
Comfortable beds and cozy rooms are praised, but guests also report dated rooms, a rattling or broken heater, and damp musty conditions.
One guest found it great value in season; another found it disappointing for the price.
Guests praise the harbor setting, water views, and walkability to docks, dinner, and the marina, with no complaints.
Four guests found rooms quiet, while three reported thin walls, hallway sound, or noisy neighbors until 2 a.m.
Parking is described as a nightmare and as tight, with only one guest saying they managed.
Both guests who mention wifi report problems: evening dropouts and slowness for work calls.
One guest praised the Northern Michigan charm; another booked a lakeview room and got a parking lot view.

actions.title: Inspect rooms for damp and mold, then fix moisture sources
actions.why: Reviews report musty damp carpet and bathroom mold, and cleanliness is a mixed theme across 11 reviews.

actions.title: Service and test every room heater before the cold season
actions.why: Guests report a rattling heater and a heater that failed on a cold night, with staff unable to move them.

actions.title: Add a housekeeping checklist with a supervisor spot-check per room
actions.why: One guest found trash still in the bin and another a moldy bathroom, while most others call rooms spotless, so consistency is the gap.

actions.title: Upgrade wifi coverage and capacity for evening and work-call use
actions.why: Both guests who mention wifi report evening dropouts or slowness for work calls, and it scores 1 of 5.

actions.title: Set a baseline breakfast menu with hot items and restock plan
actions.why: Praise for cinnamon rolls sits beside reports of packaged muffins, minimal choice, and food running out by eight.

authenticity.note: Each flag is a signal for review, not a verdict. Confirm keeps its reviews out of the verified rating and the synthesis; dismiss returns them.

flags.rationale: 5 reviews share near duplicate phrasing: peak Jaccard similarity 0.92 (mean 0.79) against a threshold of 0.55.
5 5-star reviews posted within 2 days (2026-06-03 to 2026-06-05); threshold is 3 within 4 days.
5 reviews share near duplicate meaning: peak cosine similarity 1.00 (mean 0.99) against a threshold of 0.85; 0 of 10 pairs in the group were not caught by word overlap.
Language resembles reviews written without a stay: p = 0.82 (threshold 0.80). Cues toward deceptive: 'amazing', 'hotel in', 'staff and'; toward truthful: 'michigan', 'in', 'staff'.
Language resembles reviews written without a stay: p = 0.82 (threshold 0.80). Cues toward deceptive: 'amazing', 'hotel in', 'staff and'; toward truthful: 'michigan', 'by', 'in'.

thresholds.duplicate_phrasing: Jaccard word overlap at or above 0.55
thresholds.rating_burst: 3 or more same rating reviews within 4 days
thresholds.claim_duplicate: at least 2 shared specific claims, then a model judgment per pair (strict prompt)

methods.flag_decisions_by: automatic: every flag confirmed without review (evaluation run)
